info.title: Kyber — Infoware Domino design REST API
info.description: Kyber (Infoware): CRUD for Domino design elements via Domino REST API (/api/kyber-v1). Create/update accepts raw DXL (text/xml) with a typed root element. Bulk GET/PUT /designdxl transfers all supported elements as CRUD-identical DXL. PUT /designdxl creates the NSF if missing (bulk import only); per-type CRUD requires an existing database. This API never deletes databases. Starter DXL resolution: if kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), use the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl.

tags.name: design-element
tags.description: Per-type and singleton design-element CRUD against an NSF (?nsfPath=). Create/update bodies are raw DXL (text/xml) with a typed root. Named collections support list/create on the collection path and get/update/delete on /{name}. Application Properties and the database icon are always present (GET/PUT only).

tags.name: design-handler
tags.description: Starter DXL defaults (GET /defaults, GET /defaults/{type}?kind=) and bulk export/import (GET/PUT /designdxl). If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. PUT /designdxl creates the NSF if missing (bulk-only). POST /xpagesproject ensures the minimal XPages project skeleton.

/defaults.summary: List starter design DXL from kyber.nsf or embedded JAR
/defaults.description: Starter DXL catalog. If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. Kinded types (agents, script libraries, Java sources) emit one entry per kind.

get.description: Returns { defaultNsf, elements: [{ type, name, dxl, source, kind? }] }. Per type/kind: If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. Agents, script libraries, and Java sources appear once per kind.

/defaults/{type}.summary: Get starter DXL for one design type

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Design type key (view, form, page, …) or plural (views, forms, …).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Kind when type is agent (lotusscript|formula|simpleaction|java|importedjava), scriptlibrary (lotusscript|javascript|ssjs|java), or javasource (class|interface|enum). Ignored for other types.

get.summary: Get starter design DXL for a type
get.description: Returns starter DXL for one design type. If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. For kinded types pass ?kind=: agents (lotusscript|formula|simpleaction|java|importedjava); scriptlibraries (lotusscript|javascript|ssjs|java); javasources (class|interface|enum - name is a Java path ending in .java).

/defaults/{type}.description: Returns starter DXL for the given type. If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. Pass ?kind= for agents, script libraries, and Java sources.

/designdxl.summary: Bulk export or import all supported design elements as DXL
/designdxl.description: GET exports every supported design element as CRUD-identical DXL. PUT imports an elements array (same DXL as per-type CRUD). Missing NSF is created on PUT only. Optional ?dbTitle= sets the database title when the NSF is created. Requires ?nsfPath=.

parameters.name: nsfPath
parameters.description: Target Domino database filepath (created on PUT if missing)

parameters.name: dbTitle
parameters.description: Database title to set when PUT creates a missing NSF (ignored if the NSF already exists). Prefer dbTitle over title — KEEP may already populate title from the bootstrap database.

get.description: Returns { nsfPath, elements: [{ type, name?, dxl }] } for all supported design types. Requires ?nsfPath=. NSF must already exist.

put.summary: Bulk import design DXL
put.description: Import elements with REPLACE_ELSE_CREATE, sign after each import, then compile LotusScript. Creates the NSF when missing (bulk import only). Optional ?dbTitle= sets Database.setTitle when created. Requires ?nsfPath=.

unid.description: Optional note UNID (for delete or precise replace)

delete.description: When true, delete the named/UNID design note instead of importing (dxl may be omitted)

dbTitle.description: Present when the NSF was created and ?dbTitle= was set

/pages.description: List page names (GET) or create a page (POST) in the target NSF (?nsfPath=). Get/update/delete use /pages/{name}.

post.summary: Create a page (409 if name exists)
post.description: Create-only. Body: raw DXL (text/xml) with a typed root element. Optional ?name= sets/renames the element on create. Empty body creates from starter DXL when ?name= is set. Starter resolution: If kyber.nsf (or kyber.defaultNsf) exists and has the type (and kind when kinded), uses the first match by case-insensitive alphabetical name; otherwise embedded JAR /defaults/{type}.dxl. Requires ?nsfPath=. Responds 409 if the name already exists.
